title: design-spec
description: Result of a game-designer run (game profile, owner 20.11): complete documents to write into the repository (GAME-DESIGN.md, balance tables), what changed in the balance and how to read the effect, suggestions for the PO, questions for the owner.

summary.description: what this run decided and why, 2–6 sentences

content.description: the COMPLETE file, not a diff

why.description: the observation, metric or rule it answers

read_in.description: which metric or tester scenario will show whether it worked, and after how many rounds

proposed_tasks.description: suggestions for the PO; they become observations, the PO decides

open_questions.description: only what changes the genre, the audience or money — the owner decides

friction.description: where the framework got in the way: missing input, unclear task, schema that did not fit
